question: F44: Four CD-burn sessions ran on 2015-03-24 at 19:47:47, 19:56:01–19:56:11, 20:24:19–20:24:46 and 20:41:21; each left burn temp files and a CD-drive event.
english: CD-burn trace in the System event log: cdrom driver event 133 for \Device\CdRom0 (2015-03-24 20:41:21 UTC). Windows leaves this trace when it writes a disc; it does not show what was written (heuristic rule R12).
